speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for sharing your history. To better understand your condition, can you tell me how long you've been experiencing fatigue, malaise, and unintentional weight loss?

speaker: Patient
text: 71-year-old male. The patient complains of fatigue and malaise over the last few months. He also reports an unintentional weight loss of 18.1 kg over the past 6 months. He does not recall any changes in diet or exercise routines that could explain the weight loss.

speaker: Doctor
text: I see significant weight loss; have you noticed any night sweats, fevers, or loss of appetite accompanying these symptoms? Also, have you experienced any persistent cough or shortness of breath?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Fatigue and malaise. I also have Significant unintentional weight loss, No change in diet or exercise.

speaker: Doctor
text:
Given the significant weight loss and constitutional symptoms, I need to rule out malignancy. Have you noticed any lumps or swelling in your neck, armpits, or groin recently?

REQUEST TEST: Complete Blood Count (CBC) with differential and Comprehensive Metabolic Panel (CMP).
REQUEST TEST: LDH and ESR.

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Complete Blood Count (CBC) with differential: WBC Elevated with lymphocytosis; Hemoglobin Normal to slightly decreased; Platelets Normal to decreased. Comprehensive Metabolic Panel (CMP): Normal Readings. LDH and ESR: Normal Readings.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given the lymphocytosis and significant weight loss, have you noticed any enlarged lymph nodes, night sweats, or a persistent cough? REQUEST TEST: Chest_X-Ray. REQUEST IMAGES.
